grammar.title: Hurry up and... with 赶快
grammar.explanation: 赶快 (gǎnkuài) means "hurry up and, quickly" — used to urge someone to act fast, often in a request or command. It goes right before the verb.

sentences.pinyin: Gǎnkuài zǒu ba, shíjiān bù duō le.
sentences.en: Hurry up and go, there isn't much time left.
Hurry up and go to the hospital.

sentences.pinyin: Tā gǎnkuài bǎ mén guānshàng le.
